reports.title: Gap Inc. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2026 Outlook
section: The Company's updated full-year outlook factors in quarter-to-date performance reflecting a slower than expected start to the fourth quarter, followed by recent improvement as weather has normalized.
On a reported basis, the Company now expects full year diluted earnings per share to be approximately $3.71 to $3.76.
On an adjusted non-GAAP basis, the Company's updated outlook is outlined below:

desk.headline: Sales up 2% to $4.0bn, in line; adjusted EPS $0.82 beats; full-year outlook cut after slow, warm start to Q4

numbers.eps_basis: adjusted (excludes tariff refunds); GAAP diluted EPS $0.86

other.label: Gap brand comparable sales
other.change: 12th quarter in a row of growth

results: Net sales rose 2% to $4.0bn with comparable sales flat; online grew 3% and is 40% of sales.
Gap brand was the standout (sales +11%, comps +9%); Old Navy comps were flat, Banana Republic fell 3% and Athleta dropped 15%.
Adjusted gross margin was flat at 42.4%; adjusted operating margin was 9.8%, ahead of the company's plan.
Adjusted EPS was $0.82 (GAAP $0.86, up from $0.62), beating the analyst estimate.
Cash and short-term investments reached $3.0bn; $788m has been returned to shareholders this year and inventory is down 6%.

guidance.summary: Gap cut its full-year outlook after a slower-than-expected start to Q4 in warm weather. Sales are now seen roughly flat (was up 1%-1.5%) and adjusted EPS at $2.29-$2.34 (was $2.35-$2.45). Q4 sales are guided flat to down 1%.

points: Management said apparel demand cooled in October and early November as warm weather hurt sweater and outerwear sales, then improved as it got colder.
The holiday plan assumes only slight further improvement and includes more promotions after the slow November start.
Gap brand comps are expected to grow high single digits in Q4; Old Navy comps are seen down 1%-2%.
Athleta was called a turnaround: a new CEO starts 14 December and a full review is planned, with Q4 expected to be tougher.
The CEO said the outlook is the best view today but the aim is to do better over the holidays.

watch: Holiday trading, especially Old Navy after extra promotions.
Athleta's review under its new CEO.
Q4 gross margin against the 38.0%-38.3% guide and the tariff-rate assumptions.
